Default priors for the Macrocystis nitrogen model

Source: R/kb_priors_nitrogen_macro.R
kb_priors_nitrogen_macro.Rd

The default priors for the Macrocystis pyrifera nitrogen model, for the priors argument of kb_fit_nitrogen_macro().

Usage

kb_priors_nitrogen_macro()

Value

A named list of prior objects, one per parameter.

Priors

Each entry is named after the parameter it sets, which kb_model_describe() prints with the model. A list passed to priors replaces the entries it names; the others keep their defaults. The prior family of each entry is fixed; only its arguments can be changed.

See also

Other priors: kb_prior_exponential(), kb_prior_lognormal(), kb_prior_normal(), kb_priors_carbon_macro(), kb_priors_carbon_nereo(), kb_priors_cover_calibration_macro(), kb_priors_cover_calibration_nereo(), kb_priors_nitrogen_nereo(), kb_priors_size_nereo(), kb_priors_weight_macro(), kb_priors_weight_nereo(), kb_priors_wetdry_macro(), kb_priors_wetdry_nereo()

Examples

kb_priors_nitrogen_macro()
#> $intercept
#> normal(mean = -3.7, sd = 0.5)
#> 
#> $precision
#> exponential(rate = 0.001)
#> 
if (FALSE) { # interactive()
# Change one prior; the others keep their defaults:
kb_fit_nitrogen_macro(
  data_nitrogen_sim_macro,
  priors = list(intercept = kb_prior_normal(mean = -3.5, sd = 0.5))
)
}
